ABOUT ZEL

We are ZEL,a digital studio

We design and build distinctive websites, commerce platforms and tools for businesses with ambitious ideas.

WHAT WE DO

From idea to launch

  1. 01

    Strategy & direction

    We start with the business: who it serves, what it needs to do, and what will make it stand apart.

  2. 02

    Design

    Interfaces with a clear point of view, with typography, motion and interaction shaped around the brand.

  3. 03

    Development

    Fast, accessible builds: storefronts, ordering platforms, dashboards and the tools behind them.

  4. 04

    Launch & growth

    We ship, measure and refine, so the work keeps improving long after launch day.

OUR APPROACH
